body:
The second key feels heavier than the first, its texture rough against my palm as I pick it up. The communal board hums with activity, everyone staring at me curiously, their faces full of concern masking any suspicion or alarm. My heart races, but I force a deep breath in through my nose, exhaling slowly out through my mouth. 

I hold the key tightly in both hands, feeling its cold metal against mine. Each touch sends a surge of protectiveness through me, a sense that this new key holds something special—a potential safeguard for our shared space.
